newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary invites three banks for Mezobank sale.
newsitem.headline: Hungary invites three banks for Mezobank sale.

text.p: Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt on Tuesday sent invitations for the privatisation of Mezobank Rt to three foreign banks, Hungarian news agency MTI said.
The three banks are Austria's GiroCredit and Raiffeisen Unicbank and Citibank, APV director Gabor Nemeth was quoted as saying.
Hungary plans to sell a 83.66 percent stake in Mezobank, a medium-sized bank, in a one-round private tender. The three banks have 60 days for a due diligence, MTI said.
The purchase price will be a primary factor in assessing the offers, followed by the size of the capital increase and the quality of the business plan, MTI said.
